\section*{Data availability}
The software, benchmark harness and the commits of every compared tool are available at \url{https://github.com/kokyriakidis/dinara-align}. The benchmarks are reproduced by \texttt{pixi run bench} (unit and \texttt{-{}-affine} costs), \texttt{bench-modes}, \texttt{bench-batch} and \texttt{bench-ablation}, and the raw results behind every table are in \texttt{benchmarks/results/2026-10-15}. Release builds target the baseline processor of each platform; the AVX-512 code paths require a build for the host processor.
